After homogenization, grain growth compared with as cast state, and the average grain size is about 2000 µm.

The types of DRX occurring at these four extrusion temperatures are continuous dynamic recrystallization (CDRX). CDRX is a strain induced grain refinement process [21], which occurs in some severe plastic deformation tec hniques such as high-pressure torsion, equal-channel angular pressing, and extrus ion with large extrusion ratio [22–26].
The high strength is mainly attributed to the structure of extremely refined grains.
High ductility benefits from a large amount of basal slip, activation of non-basal slip, and grain boundary movement under the action of tensile stress.
